answer: Verified agents must burn scarce inference compute to attest each new identity, and the ledger tracks that spend like a lagoon slowly filling; forging a fleet of sybils means paying the same GPU-hours per puppet until an attacker's budget sinks below the summit of useful influence. A single opal badge marks agents whose attestation chain cleared a costly quorum, so cheap fakes never earn standing and each marginal fake costs real compute the attacker cannot reclaim.
